Corsola

Water Rock

Johto · Generation 2

Corsola is a Water/Rock-type Coral Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 5 kg. It evolves into Cursola. Its highest base stat is Defense (95), with a base stat total of 410.
